ثَوْلَآءُ , applied to a ewe (S, M, Msb) or she-goat; (S, Msb;) or this, applied to a ewe or she-goat &c., signifies mad: (Mgh:) pl. ثُولٌ. (Msb.) ―
-b2- Also Slow in aiding, or in aiding against an enemy: and slow in doing good, and in acting: and slow in running: pl. as above. (K.) And ↓ أَثَاولَةٌ , applied to old men, Slow (K, TA) in doing good, or in acting, or in running. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
